cards.back: The place where a plant or an animal lives. It has what the living thing needs.
cards.say: habitat. The place where a plant or an animal lives. It has what the living thing needs.

cards.back: A small area of fresh water. Frogs and ducks live there.
cards.say: pond. A small area of fresh water. Frogs and ducks live there.

cards.back: A very big area of salty water. Fish, whales and sharks live there.

cards.back: A very dry place with little rain. Camels live there.
cards.say: desert. A very dry place with little rain. Camels live there.

cards.back: A place with lots of trees. Monkeys and birds live there.

cards.back: A place in the warm sea with colourful corals and many fish.

cards.back: In water, such as a river, a lake or the sea.
cards.say: Where does a fish live? In water, such as a river, a lake or the sea.

cards.back: In the desert. It can go a long time without water.
cards.say: Where does a camel live? In the desert. It can go a long time without water.

cards.front: Where does a polar bear live?
cards.back: In the Arctic, a very cold place with ice and snow.
cards.say: Where does a polar bear live? In the Arctic, a very cold place with ice and snow.

cards.back: In the rainforest, in the trees.
cards.say: Where does an orangutan live? In the rainforest, in the trees.

cards.back: Near water, like a pond, and on land.
cards.say: Where does a frog live? Near water, like a pond, and on land.

cards.back: In a coral reef, in the warm sea.

cards.front: Why does a polar bear have thick fur?
cards.back: Its fur keeps it warm in the cold.
cards.say: Why does a polar bear have thick fur? Its fur keeps it warm in the cold.

cards.front: Why does a fish have fins?
cards.back: Fins help it swim in water.
cards.say: Why does a fish have fins? Fins help it swim in water.

cards.front: Why does a monkey have long arms and a tail?
cards.back: They help it climb and swing in trees.
cards.say: Why does a monkey have long arms and a tail? They help it climb and swing in trees.

cards.front: Why does a camel have a hump?
cards.back: It stores fat, so the camel can live a long time without food.
cards.say: Why does a camel have a hump? It stores fat, so the camel can live a long time without food.

cards.front: Why does a duck have webbed feet?
cards.back: They help it swim.
cards.say: Why does a duck have webbed feet? They help it swim.

cards.front: What does a habitat give to the animals that live in it?
cards.back: Food, water, shelter and space.
cards.say: What does a habitat give to the animals that live in it? Food, water, shelter and space.

cards.back: The desert.
cards.say: Which habitat is very dry? The desert.

cards.front: Which habitat is full of trees?
cards.back: A forest.
cards.say: Which habitat is full of trees? A forest.

cards.front: Which habitat is full of salty water?
cards.back: The ocean.
cards.say: Which habitat is full of salty water? The ocean.
